categories.name: Instances
categories.description: Endpoints for listing and retrieving instances. An instance is an isolated environment within a Metorial project. Instances are created via the dashboard (since API keys are scoped to instances). Common setups include production, staging, and development instances.

categories.name: Providers
categories.description: A provider is a read-only template for an MCP server integration (like GitHub or Slack). To use a provider, create a deployment from it.

categories.name: Custom Providers
categories.description: Custom providers allow you to deploy your own MCP servers. Create providers from container images, remote URLs, or serverless functions.

categories.name: Identities
categories.description: Identities bundle credentials under a single owner actor so provider access can be managed and delegated consistently.

categories.name: Sessions
categories.description: Sessions are connections to providers that allow clients to interact with MCP servers. Each session can include one or more provider deployments.

categories.name: Magic MCP
categories.description: Magic MCP servers are stable MCP entrypoints backed by a session template. Group servers, combine them behind routed endpoints, and manage the tokens that authorize access to them.

categories.name: Skills
categories.description: Skills group provider and integration capabilities into reusable, owned compositions.

categories.name: Files
categories.description: Represents files that you have uploaded to Metorial. Files can be linked to various resources based on their purpose. Metorial can also automatically extract files for you, for example for data exports.

categories.name: Stores
categories.description: Create and manage instance stores backed by Cargo.

categories.name: Sandboxes
categories.description: Sandboxes are isolated machines that boot from an image and can mount disks. Create and operate machines, run commands on them, build images from a Dockerfile, and manage disks, regions, and machine sizes.

categories.name: Chat
categories.description: Chat links providers such as Slack and Microsoft Teams to your instance. Manage chat connections and chat instances, and read their workspaces and events.

categories.name: Callbacks
categories.description: A callback is what receives provider events for an integration provider. Creating one enables callbacks on the integration provider, and Metorial then registers the callback against every matching integration instance. Setting `callbacks.status` on the integration provider itself does the same thing.

categories.name: Events
categories.description: Events are the record of everything Metorial delivers to your event destinations — normal resource events, callback occurrences, chat connection events, and manual pings.

categories.name: Network Access
categories.description: Network access controls how integrations and sandbox machines reach the network. Read integration enclaves and the internet gateway, and manage firewalls, their assignments, and reusable network policies.

categories.name: Monitoring
categories.description: Monitoring tracks automated checks on your instance. Read monitors and ProtoGuard prompt-injection settings, and review and resolve alerts for detected prompt-injection or schema-change events.

categories.name: Portal
categories.description: Use Portals to create custom branded MCP server marketplaces for your organization.

categories.name: Consumers
categories.description: Manage instance consumers independently from portals and inspect the profiles linked to each consumer.

categories.name: Integrations
categories.description: Integrations define reusable provider contracts that can then be materialized into integration instances.

categories.name: API Key
categories.description: Read and write API key information. The secret of a newly created API key is shown only once, when it is created.

categories.name: Outpost
categories.description: Read and write outposts, their access grants, and credentials
